overview: Weapon and armor mods grant a core effect plus randomized stat attributes; the number of attributes scales with the mod's rarity tier. Once Human's full mod pool spans 773 combinations (per oncehumandb.com) across weapon effects like Shrapnel, Power Surge, Frost Vortex, Bounce, Fast Gunner, Burn, Unstable Bomber, Fortress Warfare and Marked (Bull's Eye). Below is a curated list of named mods grouped by the weapon effect / archetype they support.

groups.description: Bullets fragment on impact, dealing extra damage per body part hit.

mods.name: Obliterate
mods.effect: Shrapnel damage increases 15% per part hit.

mods.name: Shatter Them All
mods.effect: Shrapnel damage increases 15% per part hit.

mods.name: Shield Breaker
mods.effect: Hitting shielded units increases Shrapnel DMG by 60% for 1 second.

mods.name: Shrapnel Smash
mods.effect: Shrapnel triggers increase Crit Rate by 1%, stackable 20x for 2 seconds.

mods.name: Shrapnel Souvenir
mods.effect: When Shrapnel hits a Weakspot, reloads 1 bullet from reserves.

groups.description: Shots build stacks of Electric/Shock damage, exploding into a burst.

mods.name: Shock Diffusion
mods.effect: Power Surge spreads Shock to nearby units within 5 meters.

mods.name: Shock Rampage
mods.effect: Power Surge damage increases trigger factor by 10%, stackable 3x.

mods.name: Static Shock
mods.effect: Shock State time -50%; Power Surge DMG +20%.

mods.name: Surge Amplifier
mods.effect: Power Surge damage grants up to 4 stacks of +5% for 3 seconds.

groups.description: Creates a vortex that deals PSI Intensity as status damage over time and can freeze enemies.

mods.name: Cryo Blast
mods.effect: Frost Vortex inflicts Frostbite: Vulnerability +4%, Movement Speed -10%.

mods.name: Frosty Blessing
mods.effect: When a Frost Vortex disappears, recovers 10% HP.

mods.name: Shattering Ice
mods.effect: Defeating frost-trapped enemies deals Frost DMG equal to 50% Psi Intensity.

mods.name: Vortex Multiplier
mods.effect: Maximum Frost Vortexes +1, Frost Vortex DMG +10%.

mods.name: Blaze Blessing
mods.effect: Killing an enemy in Burn status recovers 5% HP.

mods.name: Burning Wrath
mods.effect: 25% chance to apply 1 extra Burn stack on inflicting Burn.

mods.name: Embers
mods.effect: When Burn status is removed from an enemy, only 50% of stacks are lost.

mods.name: Flame Resonance
mods.effect: Increases maximum Burn stacks by 2 but reduces duration by 20%.

groups.description: Shots build to a bomb-like detonation.

mods.name: Bombardier Souvenir
mods.effect: Triggering Unstable Bomber reloads 15% of the magazine.

mods.name: Decisive Blow
mods.effect: After a bullet hits a Weakspot, Unstable Bomber DMG +15% for 3 seconds.

mods.name: Heavy Explosives
mods.effect: Unstable Bomber impacts enemies with additional area damage.

mods.name: Reckless Bomber
mods.effect: For every 1% Crit Rate, Unstable Bomber DMG +0.5%.

mods.name: Super Charged
mods.effect: Unstable Bomber damage increases 5% per trigger, stackable 6x.

groups.description: Rewards sustained fire and weapon switching with damage/reload buffs.

mods.name: Cowboy
mods.effect: Reloading boosts Fast Gunner trigger factor by 100% for 5 seconds.

mods.name: Double Gunner
mods.effect: Fast Gunner weapon switching increases first 6 bullets' damage by 30%.

mods.name: Fast Refurbish
mods.effect: Fast Gunner triggers Reload Speed +30% for 5 seconds, stackable 3x.

mods.name: Lasting Fortification
mods.effect: Fast Gunner max stacks increase by 1, each granting 5% Weapon DMG.

mods.name: Precision Rush
mods.effect: Fast Gunner rapid firing increases Weakspot DMG up to +45% over 3 seconds.

mods.name: Shoot Out
mods.effect: Fast Gunner grants Weapon DMG +1.5% for 10 seconds, stackable 20x.

mods.name: Shooting Blitz
mods.effect: Fast Gunner duration +4 seconds, Weapon DMG +15% during activation.

groups.description: Projectiles ricochet between enemies, excelling against groups.

mods.name: Bounce Rampage
mods.effect: Bounce damage increases up to 45% based on target count.

mods.name: Not Throw Away Your Shot
mods.effect: Bounces hit allies without damage, recovering 1 bullet.

mods.name: Super Bullet
mods.effect: Bounce Crit Rate +10%, Bounce Crit DMG +25%.

mods.name: Targeted Bounce
mods.effect: Bounce is 300% more likely to hit a Weakspot.

groups.description: Territory/turtling-oriented effect tied to structures and sustained fights.

mods.name: Durable Territory
mods.effect: Defeating enemies extends Fortress Warfare duration, up to 5 times.

mods.name: Final Territory
mods.effect: After Fortress Warfare ends: Weapon DMG +10%, Movement Speed +10%.

mods.name: Portable Territory
mods.effect: After leaving Fortress Warfare, the status remains for 2 seconds.

mods.name: United We Stand
mods.effect: Fortress Warfare damage bonus increases with nearby players, up to 40%.

groups.description: Marking enemies for bonus team damage.

mods.name: Hunters Perk
mods.effect: DMG dealt by Marked enemies against Metas is decreased by 20% (defensive utility).

mods.name: Recover Mark
mods.effect: Defeating marked enemies grants HP +15%, Stamina +25%.

mods.name: Spreading Marks
mods.effect: Defeated marked enemies transfer their status to nearby enemies within 15m.

mods.name: Vulnerability Amplifier
mods.effect: Increases Bull's Eye Vulnerability effect by 8%.
